title: Activities — verified hours/tickets/social links where official sources allow

activities.name: Yu Garden (豫园)
activities.exceptions: Closed every Monday, except national statutory holidays; Spring Festival hours announced separately by the park
activities.tickets: Off-season (Dec 1–Mar 31, covers Feb 2027): ¥30/adult. Peak (Apr 1–Jun 30, Sep 1–Nov 30): ¥40/adult. Half-price for students and 60+; free for children ≤1.3 m / ≤6 years (with adult) and listed eligible groups. Official purchase via the '上海豫园' official WeChat mini-program or on-site counters.
activities.social: Official WeChat mini-program '上海豫园' (official sales channel) — no verified YouTube/TikTok/IG account
activities.transit: Huangpu district — same district as Xintiandi/Bund hotels (walk/metro ≤1h: time not verified — see flagged)

activities.name: Shanghai Museum — People's Square Hall
activities.exceptions: Closed Monday except national statutory holidays; during the Americas Ancient Civilizations exhibition the hall requires a paid ticket
activities.tickets: Permanent collection free; special exhibition ticketed (price not yet verified — flagged)
